title: A DEAD BULWARK LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Bulwark left the generic brown wreck. It now leaves its own: the big shield slab fallen flat with its ochre chevron band and rust edge trim, the hunched body slumped beside it with its rust plate and a stompy foot, the sensor dome rolled off with a dead eye. Smoke while unsearched. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Bulwark leaves its slab and a smoking wreck.
